title: Coast Guard rescues man from vessel taking on water in Little Back River, GA
description: Coast Guard Air Station Savannah MH-65 helicopter aircrew hoist an 81-year-old man from his 16-foot vessel taking on water Apr. 24, 2022, in Little Back River, Georgia. The man did not have a way to provide his exact location to the Chatham County Sheriff's Office and the Coast Guard aircrew searched for an hour to locate him. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
